items.note: The plan gives h, v, N, m, I, both gate rules, the eight-row schedule, the net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, the coefficient check per intersection size, the three-stage composition (x,y+x),(-y,y+x),(-y,x) and the exact wire counts, exactly as in the proof at 741-783. Only the headline wording 'three forward invocations' is loose (see errors).

States frames, D_in/D_out, the logical interpretation g=D_in^{-1}f, the commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate by R-linearity, the identity D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}; this is the paper's invariant argument.

Both bilinear forms, the terminal labels, the stage transitions and their fit, the gate-label table, the full residual table with dimensions, L=Ich, the budget Wm-2N+2L, the orthonormal-basis argument over F_2 and the ratios 100/539, 101/539 all match the paper's proof.

Matrices P_U and -P_{U_a}, the address shear Phi_M with Phi_{M'}Phi_M=Phi_{M'+M}, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N source exceptions (2P_{U_a} of rank one), s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b with its exact value, deficit N-2L_b>0, and the endpoint identity I_m are all given as in the proof.

Follows the proof step by step: weight additivity on orthogonal vectors, q_V-q_U as a sum over an orthonormal residual basis, odd weights giving aI+bX_v or its inverse, s_c with deficit 2N-2L_c, k columns by tensoring, the exceptional X_a->Y_a route with 27 inverse factors corrected by Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}, and the final sign and role undoing.

Gives L/N<1/2, both deficits, the exact eta_b and eta_c, the bound eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20 and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta), hence s_b/W_b<m^tau and s_c/W_c<m^sigma with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, exactly as at 1319-1346.

The plan uses the elementary stream operations and the controlled-shift lemma (row splitting, bit splits, O(V) triangular updates, cyclic shifts with L^{O(1)} offsets) and names them in 'relies on', but never states either lemma's general content (the list of O(V) digit operations, the update y->y+a(controls) mod q^b with offset prepared in b^{O(1)}).

States A=E_1 Pi E_2 with the topmost-row/rightmost-entry elimination, then the shear cost of exactly a interchanges plus O(V) via the prime choice, O(V) lower-triangular updates, the E_1/E_2 sandwich and the three-step update around one swap, all as in the paper.

Cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} on each edge by recursive interchanges, the frame identity giving Phi_{I_m}, the three-shear swap, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum to O(e^tau), and the fixed-tape schedule and descriptor bound all match the proof.

Reproduces k, rho, the high-digit row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding to R', the base-m decomposition of e-rho, the geometric sum O(Ve^tau), padding binary ranges to [q^e], and the one-bit-difference case.

Edge kernels per residual vector, conjugation P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv}, slots and columns, one child per kernel with inverses via (-i)^f Z C Z, at most m(m-1)+3m row additions, s_c children on e/m axes, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D, as in 1835-1940.

The eight updates and their parity cycles, guard values, packed cyclic shifts, the bad set with delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, the swap/rotation implementation, radix-sort repair, the cost and its vanishing extra terms, and the application to a change of basis all follow the proof.

Individual kernels O(Ve), node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), rows from the first q_0 chunks padded to multiples of W^{k_0}, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e), K<=e^{c/beta}, the internal and leaf sums, and the base-m partition giving O(d^{lambda'}) match the paper.

States the layer, O(Vd^{lambda'}), single truncation with error <sqrt2 2^{-p}, and derives the guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) via A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, nu=11, C_1=20, then the uniformity check of the packed terms and the disk argument, as in the proof.

Character cancellation with y^{rj_0}=-1, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed storage B_t, the reversed procedure giving F_t^+B_t^{-1}, the prefix moves and chunk exchanges defining L with costs O(TpdK) and O(Tp pK^{tau-1}), layer rounds O(Tp l d^{lambda'}), J_E Q_p = Q_p J_E, error <sqrt2 l 2^{-p}, and the operators LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}.

B_0=2^{4p}, evaluation bound, four products, separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, two's-complement carries in {-1,0}, centered extraction with carries in {0,1} and the residual identity, negacyclic reduction, and the final shift by p+l are all as in the proof.

Retained LB order, the normalization identity, P(LBu,LBv)=LBP(u,v), the error chain 2delta, 2delta+eta, 3delta+eta and the final factor M giving sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, and the cost with the exact scale, all match 3414-3495.

The maps S, T, selection C, diagonal D, N=CTD with the cited identity and estimate, the Neumann inverse, the normalizations multiplying to 2^{-2alpha^2}, the ordered numerical maps and the tensor implementation with axis exposure O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) follow the paper; one sub-step misplaces a window radius (see errors) without affecting the result.

Periodicity of the chirp, the coefficient identity via j^2-(j-k)^2+k^2=2jk, Q reading frequency (-s_i j_i), RF^+R=F^+ by substitution h=ck, commutation with pointwise products and the two normalizations giving (u*v)/S^2, and conjugation for RF^+, exactly as at 3938-3988.

All fixed exponents and their checked inequalities, the sizes b,p,d,K,T,r,l, the comparison constants, alpha, gamma, eta, the prime-interval count, disjointness, T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the n^{o(1)} search, and the no-wraparound and capacity bounds are reproduced.

Defines Phi with mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i, proves it an isomorphism, gives the triangular formula b_i, the padding scan, the update order i=d..1, the bijection on the padded box, prefix-controlled shifts and the O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) axis-reversal cost, as in the paper.

Well-definedness (zeta y)^r=1, diagonal isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T, and the computed version with twist errors and width normalization match the paper.

Chirp construction, the computed chirp transform, the source transform with exact counterpart RF_s and its conjugate, input scaling by 2^{-b-2}, the six steps and the explanation of the two occurrences of S are all given; the top-level S8 summary swaps rounding and Phi^{-1}, but S8.8 has the paper's order (see errors).

The error chain E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, 2E_s+2, 3E_s+2, E_w<28*2^gamma T^2L, the final bound 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 using gamma<=b/4, rounding, and carry propagation with its invariant are reproduced from the paper.

All nine table rows with their powers, the seven margins with min g_2=2^{-181}=2kappa, the justification of each row, setup and exceptional streams o(V), absorption of log powers by p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff giving O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) match 4808-4995.

S0 says the bound refutes the n log n optimality conjecture but gives none of the content: the eventual lower bound T_A(n)>=c_A n lg n, its negation via liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0, or why the power saving gives limit zero.

errors.says: Three forward invocations of an eight-row schedule (from X to Y, the inverse schedule from Y to X, then X to Y) send (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a).
errors.paper: The three stages are a forward invocation from X to Y at stage 1, the inverse forward schedule from Y to X at stage 2 (effecting X <- X - Y), and a forward invocation at stage 3; the middle stage is not a forward invocation.

errors.says: The Neumann evaluation's tape movement over windows of radius about sqrt(p) alpha costs O(tp sqrt(p) alpha).
errors.paper: The radius sqrt(p) alpha belongs to the S' procedure; each E-tilde call in the Neumann evaluation uses a window of radius m=ceil(sqrt(p)/(2alpha)) costing O(tp(1+sqrt(p)/alpha)), and the k-1<=alpha^2 calls give O(tp sqrt(p) alpha).

errors.says: The algorithm applies the opposite source transform and the two scales by S, undoes Phi, then rounds to integers and propagates carries.
errors.paper: Step 5 multiplies by 2^{2b+4}S, rounds at each valid address in tensor order and writes (3b+1)-bit words, and only then applies Phi^{-1}; the second scale is 2^{2b+4}S, not S alone. Sub-step S8.8 states this correctly.

chain: The plan reaches the main bound by the paper's own route. It goes from the scalar bank-exchange network, frames and subspace labels to the two interfaces with s<Wm and tau=1-2^{-50}, then through power-width and arbitrary-width interchange and the phase-frame layer recursion (with packed basis changes and guard bits) to synthetic transforms, signed packing, ring convolution, resampling, the chirp and R-cancellation, parameters, CRT, the twist, the six-step algorithm, exact recovery, and the cost table with minimum margin 2kappa. It thins out only where it uses the elementary-stream and controlled-shift lemmas without stating them and where it names the refutation of the n log n conjecture without the liminf argument. The three minor slips do not break the chain.

steps.note: S2.1.1 gives h=100, banks X_a,Y_a indexed by a in T^3, N=v^3 with v=binom(100,3), m=h^3. S2.1 and S2.1.5 give the fixed network sending (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) and restoring every scratch wire.

It carries the common frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the point that edges only change frames, so intermediate frames can be chosen to make edges cheap.
Nondegenerate labels in F^{tensor 3} of dimension m are assigned to gates and terminals. Every edge joins comparable labels, and the only decreasing edges are central 3->4, each losing h.
S2.4.1.3 states rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate labels. S2.4.1.4 names the N source exceptions, each edge matrix 2P_{U_a} of rank one with zero dimension change.
S2.3.4 and S2.3.11 give the sum of |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich. S2.4.1.4 gives s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b with its exact value.
The ratios 100/539 and 101/539 are shown to be below 1/2, with deficit N-2L_b>0 for the bit network (and 2N-2L_c>0 for the complex one), hence s<Wm.
S2.4.1.6 gives M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every input role via P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m. S2.5.3.3 turns this into the shear H<-H+D on every row, including scratch rows.
It gives the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2, the shear costing exactly a interchanges plus O(V), each edge Phi_{A_e} implemented by recursive interchanges, and exactly s recursive calls per node.
It covers children of volume V/W, F_0=O(1) and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the exponent tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 giving s/W<m^tau, and the geometric sum giving F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central saving in the paper's order: the fixed h=100 bank-exchange network, frames, labels with only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, rank equal to dimension change with N rank-one source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b, L/N=100/539 below 1/2 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity I_m, rank-a shears as a recursive calls, and the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with tau=1-2^{-50}. Each step carries its defining quantity.
